title: Monkey Market
description: Generate pseudo-random secrets and optimise banana purchases via price change sequences.
writeup:
## Approach

Each buyer generates a sequence of 2000 pseudo-random secret numbers using bitwise operations (XOR with shifts, masked to 24 bits). The price is the last digit of each secret.

## Part 1

Simulate 2000 iterations for each buyer and sum the final secrets.

## Part 2

Find the 4-element sequence of price changes that maximises total bananas across all buyers. For each buyer, compute price changes and record the first time each 4-change tuple appears (along with the price at that point). Aggregate across all buyers using a dictionary. The sequence with the highest total wins.

This avoids brute-forcing all possible 4-tuples by only considering sequences that actually appear in the data.
